correctness.rationale: Conditional on U0>1/2, the B antithetic pairs contribute independent Bernoulli(2(1-U0)) counts, whose uniform mixing gives each c=0..B probability 1/(B+1). The complementary U0<1/2 half yields B plus a uniform number of additional exceedances. Averaging creates masses 1/[2(B+1)] except double central mass j=B+1, the displayed piecewise CDF, first failure alpha*=(B+1)/(2B+1), and maximal excess B/[2(B+1)(2B+1)]. This proves all B>=1, not only finite checks. Independently recomputed exact rational distributions for B=1..100 from the mass/CDF identities and checked first failing j and maximum. Domain: U0 and B latent U independent, strictly increasing continuous F; not generic dependent permutations.
residual_risks: No claim for discrete F, arbitrary antithetic permutations, or estimated null distributions.
